HMO

Your employees are your greatest asset—and their health is key to your company’s success. With rising healthcare costs and increasing wellness needs, offering HMO is more than a benefit—it’s a strategic advantage.

At Trinity, we offer a comprehensive HMO or Health Maintenance Organization, a healthcare delivery system that provides healthcare and services for its members. It is responsible for the payment of an insured's medical expenses, doctor's fees, hospitalization, clinic visits, and other medical care such as outpatient consultation and diagnostics.

HMO coverage may be customized:
• In-Patient benefits (inclusion of Claimability Assessment)
• Out-Patient benefits including ancillary benefits (e.g. laboratory tests and diagnostic procedures)
• Emergency Care benefits
• Annual Physical Examination
• Dental Benefits
• Financial Assistance
• Daily Hospital Income Benefit
• Maternity Benefit
• Repatriation Clause
• Management of Medical Profile (e.g. Corporate Solutions, Wellness Programs)

For companies with 5 to 249 employees, we offer TRINITY SHIELD.

TRINITY provides a comprehensive and cost-effective HMO program to empower businesses to help their employees become healthy and well.

FULL-RISK COVERAGE includes:
• In-patient
• Out-patient
• Annual physical exam
• Emergency care
• Financial assistance
• Maternity assistance
• Dental
• Tele-consultation services
• Wellness program
• Pre-existing conditions are covered up to maximum benefit limit.

WITH FREE LIFESTYLE PACKAGE which is an expanded health & wellness benefit on top of your HMO benefit.

WITH ACCESS to a large network of hospitals and healthcare providers in the country through cashless availments and an option to use Point-of-Service (POS) feature subject to reimbursement.

FLEXIBLE PAYMENT: Annual, Semi-annual, and Quarterly.

COMMON-LAW PARTNER can now also be enrolled as a dependent.

For as low as PHP 6,000* per employee, your people can have HMO benefit for the
whole year! Inquire now using the form below.

(*depending on the number of employees, coverage, access to hospitals, etc.)

What is the information needed for HMO?

• With Existing Plan:
o Company Name
o Nature of Business
o Location
o Copy of the contract/schedule of benefits
o Utilization report
o List of employees and dependents with date of birth, civil status, gender, amount of insurance, position/job level
o Nature of business
o Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
o KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity

• Virgin Account:
o Company Name
o Nature of Business
o Location
o Preferred plan benefits, if possible
o List of employees and dependents with date of birth, civil status, gender, position/job level
o Nature of business
o Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
o KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
